The Reality Code Engine (RCE Draft 0.9) [T/E · reported_j]

Reconciles three metrics in openIE-dev/rce@f87d6af2: 49.04 mJ single-Form check vs 15.44 J full 62-Form suite (Apple M5 Max L3 reported_j) and 2,221 / 2,236 conformance passes (15 reserved).

1/2 Honest Lean 4.36.0 theorem boundary:
- 97 completed .lean files (1,264 source decls / 5,393 constants) pass 6/6 checkers in bwrap with 0 sorry
- Discloses 12 unproved Draft-0.9 theorem statements in Appendix F.9 (plus T60 & parts of T57/T59/T61)
- CLI logs integer C.6 fuel

2/2 Scoped totality & limits:
- Totality T8 prevents stuck steps inside the modeled Form core — excluding OS OOMs, FFI bugs, compiler faults & open entry item #15
- Stripping names aids hashing T7 but costs LLMs 11-29 pts without side-tables [S]
- reported_j (measured_j = null)
